topics.name: Survival & getting unstuck
topics.goal: Get attention politely, say yes/no, and ask someone to repeat, slow down or explain a word

topics.name: Eating out
topics.goal: Say how many people you are, order food and drinks, ask for water and the bill, and thank the staff

topics.name: Konbini & supermarket
topics.goal: Buy things, understand the cashier's questions (bag? heat it up?), pay by cash or card, and read price and date labels

topics.name: Asking the way
topics.goal: Ask where a place is and follow simple directions: straight, left, right, at the corner or traffic light

topics.name: Trains & buses
topics.goal: Buy a ticket, find the right platform or bus stop, understand 'next stop' announcements and get off at the right place

topics.name: Introducing yourself
topics.goal: Introduce yourself: your name, where you are from, where you live and what you do, and ask the same of others

topics.name: Time & days
topics.goal: Ask and tell the time, talk about today, tomorrow and days of the week, and understand opening hours

topics.name: Daily life
topics.goal: Say what you do every day and what you did: get up, go, come home, eat, study, shop, sleep

topics.name: Describing things
topics.goal: Describe things, places and people: big or small, cheap or expensive, tasty, quiet, convenient, and say what you like

topics.name: Home & landlord
topics.goal: Tell the landlord or management company what is broken (key, water, gas, air conditioner) and handle rubbish day

topics.name: Making friends
topics.goal: Invite someone out, agree on a time, swap contact details and react naturally in small talk

topics.name: Health & pharmacy
topics.goal: Say where it hurts and that you have a fever or a cold, buy medicine, and call for help in an emergency

topics.name: Signs & notices
topics.goal: Read everyday signs: exit and entrance, push/pull, open or closed, no entry, danger, opening hours

topics.name: Kyoto places
topics.goal: Recognise and say Kyoto Station and the main Karasuma Line station names

topics.name: Describing what you can't name
topics.goal: When you don't know a word, describe it: what it is used for, its shape or colour, what it looks like, and ask what it is called

topics.name: Road signs
topics.goal: Read the main Japanese road signs: stop, slow down, one-way, no parking, no U-turn, speed limit

topics.name: Bank & ATM
topics.goal: Open an account, withdraw and deposit money at an ATM, make a transfer, and explain a problem (lost card, forgotten PIN) to bank staff

topics.name: Post office & parcels
topics.goal: Send a letter or parcel (registered, express), buy stamps, ask the price, and get a missed delivery redelivered

topics.name: City hall paperwork
topics.goal: Register your address, get a residence certificate, handle health insurance, pension and tax forms, and ask what document is missing

topics.name: Work & employment
topics.goal: Handle job paperwork: CV and interview, contract and pay, shifts, paid leave, and tell your workplace you will be late or absent

topics.name: Clinic & hospital
topics.goal: Choose the right department, book or change an appointment, check in at reception, say what is wrong and since when, and understand tests, prescriptions and dosage

topics.name: Weather & seasons
topics.goal: Make weather small talk with neighbours, talk about Kyoto's seasons, and understand a forecast: rain, snow, typhoon, temperature

topics.name: Earthquakes & emergencies
topics.goal: Understand an earthquake early warning and shouted warnings, ask for and find the evacuation shelter, and know the words on disaster notices

topics.name: Hair, laundry & phone shop
topics.goal: Get a haircut and say how short, use a coin laundry or dry cleaner, and deal with a phone shop: smartphone, plan, charging, contract

topics.name: Clothes & shopping
topics.goal: Find clothes in your size and colour, ask to try them on and for a bigger or smaller one, say you are just looking or that you will take it, and ask for gift wrapping

topics.name: Temples, shrines & sightseeing
topics.goal: Visit Kyoto's temples and shrines: tell a temple from a shrine, read the admission fee and shoes-off signs, ask before taking photos, buy a charm or draw a fortune, and find the tourist information centre
